manifestations.description: palsy of the left sixth cranial nerve
right third nerve paresis / semi-dilated right pupil / impaired upward movement of the right eye
permanent visual field defect in both eyes / photophobia of right pupil / blurred left eye vision
very poor memory for past and recent events; difficulty in doing simple calculations
frequent dizziness / giddiness episodes two to three times per month
left sided hemihypoaesthesia (not found on later exam by Dr. Shroff)
cramps in the left calf and intermittent swelling of the left leg
right foot pain on walking for about 15 minutes; inability to put right heel to ground upstairs; limp; cannot run or walk fast
scarring of forehead, neck, right upper lip, right thigh and right foot (skin graft site) with indented/depressed forehead
loss of four teeth replaced with a denture
reduced hearing on right ear and moderate hearing loss 30 decibels
change of personality / increased introversion / irritability / mild clinical depression and anxiety

treatments_received: debridement and skin grafting on the 31st October, 1984
left craniotomy and clipping / temporary ligation of the carotid artery and removal of clots (Queen Elizabeth Hospital) (for carotid-cavernous fistula)
two-stage fascio-cutaneous flap operation on the 21st April and the 15th May, 1986
oral medication for deep vein thrombosis
denture provided by the dental surgeon of Princess Margaret Hospital

losses.description: Extensive and severe scarring of the legs, right foot and facial scars; right heel flap particularly unsightly.
Permanent visual defect in both eyes, visual field defect in both eyes; photophobia of right pupil.
Cannot run or walk fast; limp; right heel cannot touch the ground; cannot stand on right leg for stairs.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: The combination of disabilities would make it difficult at times for the plaintiff to carry out household duties; she cooks and washes sitting down and does housework slowly.
She could not return to work as a coolie and has no real prospect of finding suitable work in the future; 100% loss of future earnings was found by the court.
Her relationship with her husband is not as good as before because she cannot work and cannot do the things she is asked to do.
